Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds in document CHEMBL5291721. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5291721'. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
